name: Proverbs
title: Proverbs — Skill for Living under Yahweh
tagline: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom.

author.traditional: Solomon and other sages; Hezekiah’s men copied some (25:1).

audience: Youth and all who need ordered life.
christ: Wisdom of God (1 Cor 1); greater than Solomon; Lady Wisdom’s call fulfilled in Him.
spirit: Wisdom from above (James 3) continues the path.
jesus_in_this_book: Wisdom of God (1 Cor 1); greater than Solomon; Lady Wisdom’s call fulfilled in Him.
how_to_read: Slow. One saying at a time. Obey what is plain.
watchman_charge: Guard your heart. Reject the strange woman and the lazy path.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
